Voice of America (VOA) is the largest U.S. international broadcaster, providing news and information on TV, radio and digital platforms, in more than 45 languages, to an estimated weekly audience of over 275 million people.  Since its creation in 1942, Voice of America has been committed to providing comprehensive coverage of the news and telling audiences the truth. Through World War II, the Cold War, the fight against global terrorism, and the struggle for freedom around the globe today, VOA exemplifies the principles of a free press.
